name: Last Stop [Beta]
desc:
Like and favorite the game, it motivates us to push better updates!

Build up your bus, scavenge abandoned buildings for loot, sell what you find, gear up with powerful weapons and fight through waves of zombies, dangerous bosses and whatever else is waiting down the road.

How far can you make it... and will you reach the Last Stop?

[Controls]
Click - grab action/shoot
Z - place Build/attach
E - Equip (or use item)
Q - Drop item
R - Reload gun
TAB - Inventory
Y - Inspect
